sets.title: Form the Verbal Adverb
sets.description: Choose the correct imperfective or perfective verbal adverb
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильное деепричастие несовершенного или совершенного вида

items.promptEnglish: to think → they think → while thinking
items.explanation: Imperfective verbal adverb: думают → дума- + -я = думая (while thinking).

items.promptEnglish: to find out (pf) → found out → having found out
items.explanation: Perfective verbal adverb: узнал → узна- + -в = узнав (having found out).

items.promptEnglish: to be silent → they are silent → while being silent
items.hint: After ч, use -а instead of -я: молчат → молча.
items.explanation: After ш/ж/ч/щ: use -а. Молчат → молча (while being silent).
Perfective reflexive: вернулся → вернувшись (having returned). Reflexive adds -сь to -вши.

items.promptEnglish: to work → they work → while working
items.explanation: Imperfective verbal adverb: работают → работа- + -я = работая.
Perfective verbal adverb: открыл → откры- + -в = открыв.

minimalPairs.context: _____ книгу, он пил чай. (actions at the same time)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: While reading a book, he drank tea.

minimalPairs.context: _____ книгу, он лёг спать. (first action completed, then second)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Having read the book, he went to sleep.
minimalPairs.explanation: Prior completed action: perfective прочитав (having read).

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: While cooking dinner, she watched TV.
minimalPairs.explanation: Simultaneous: imperfective готовя (while cooking). Both actions happen at the same time.

minimalPairs.context: _____ ужин, она позвала семью. (first completed, then second)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Having cooked dinner, she called the family.
minimalPairs.explanation: Prior completed: perfective приготовив (having cooked). Cooking finished first.

sets.title: Sort and Fill
sets.description: Sort by aspect and fill in verbal adverb forms
sets.descriptionRussian: Распределите по виду и заполните формы

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these verbal adverbs: simultaneous or prior action?

blanks: _____ домой, она сняла пальто. (Having returned home, she took off her coat.)
_____ по парку, мы разговаривали. (While walking in the park, we talked.)
_____ письмо, он отправил его. (Having written the letter, he sent it.)
_____ музыку, она рисовала. (While listening to music, she drew.)
hints: She returned first, then took off her coat. Prior completed action = perfective, reflexive verb.
Walking and talking happened at the same time. Simultaneous = imperfective.
He wrote first, then sent. Prior completed = perfective.
Listening and drawing happened at the same time. Simultaneous = imperfective.
explanations: Вернувшись: pf verbal adverb of вернуться (reflexive: -вшись). Prior action: first returned, then took off coat.
Гуляя: impf verbal adverb of гулять. Simultaneous: walking and talking at the same time.
Написав: pf verbal adverb of написать. Prior action: first wrote, then sent.
Слушая: impf verbal adverb of слушать. Simultaneous: listening and drawing at the same time.

translation.english: While listening to the teacher, he took notes.
translation.hint: While listening = слушая (impf verbal adverb, simultaneous)
translation.grammarFocus: Imperfective verbal adverb for simultaneous actions

translation.english: Having finished the exam, she left.
translation.hint: Having finished = сдав or закончив (pf verbal adverb, prior)
translation.grammarFocus: Perfective verbal adverb for prior action

translation.english: While walking down the street, I met a friend.
translation.answer: Идя по улице, я встретил друга.
acceptableVariants: Идя по улице, я встретила друга.
translation.hint: While walking = идя (impf verbal adverb of идти)
translation.grammarFocus: Imperfective verbal adverb for simultaneous actions

sets.title: Tricky Forms
sets.description: Practice special formation rules and exceptions

items.promptEnglish: to hold → they hold → while holding
items.explanation: After ш/ж/ч/щ, the suffix is -а, not -я: держат → держа.

items.promptEnglish: to lie/be lying → they lie → while lying
items.explanation: Лёжа is a special form with stress shift: лежать → лёжа (while lying).

items.promptEnglish: to sit → they sit → while sitting
items.explanation: Imperfective verbal adverb: сидят → сидя (while sitting).

items.hint: Consonant stems sometimes use -я instead of -вши: принёс → принеся.
items.explanation: Some consonant-stem perfectives form verbal adverbs with -я: принести → принеся.

items.hint: Не precedes the verbal adverb as a separate word.
items.explanation: Negation: не + verbal adverb (separate words): не зная (not knowing).

items.promptEnglish: to smile → they smile → while smiling
items.explanation: Imperfective reflexive: улыбаются → улыбаясь (reflexive ending -сь after vowel).

errorCorrection.hint: A verbal adverb is needed here, not a participle.
errorCorrection.explanation: Не понимая (verbal adverb: while not understanding) replaces the incorrect participle form.
Perfective verbal adverbs end in -в/-вши, not -я/-а. Прочитав (having read).

errorCorrection.hint: -вши is archaic/dialectal after vowel stems. Modern standard: -в.
errorCorrection.explanation: After vowel stems, modern Russian uses -в, not -вши: закончив (not закончивши).

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: Comprehensive drill on verbal adverb formation and use

items.prompt: _____ дверь, он вошёл. (Having opened the door, he entered.)
items.promptEnglish: Having opened the door, he entered.
items.hint: First opened, then entered. Prior action = perfective.
items.explanation: Prior completed action: открыв (pf verbal adverb of открыть).

items.prompt: _____ по телефону, она готовила обед. (While talking on the phone, she cooked lunch.)
items.promptEnglish: While talking on the phone, she cooked lunch.
items.hint: Talking and cooking at the same time. Simultaneous = imperfective.
items.explanation: Simultaneous actions: разговаривая (impf verbal adverb of разговаривать).

items.prompt: _____ из дома, я забыл ключи. (While leaving the house, I forgot my keys.)
items.promptEnglish: While leaving the house, I forgot my keys.
items.hint: In the process of leaving (simultaneous). Imperfective: выходя.
items.explanation: Simultaneous: выходя (impf verbal adverb of выходить). Forgetting happened while leaving.

items.promptEnglish: What time relationship do imperfective verbal adverbs express?
items.hint: Читая книгу, он пил чай. Both happen at the same time.
items.explanation: Imperfective verbal adverbs express simultaneous actions: happening at the same time as the main verb.

items.promptEnglish: What time relationship do perfective verbal adverbs express?
items.hint: Прочитав книгу, он уснул. Reading finished first.
items.explanation: Perfective verbal adverbs express prior completed actions: done before the main verb.

items.prompt: _____ по улице, я увидел старого друга. (While walking, I saw an old friend.)
items.promptEnglish: While walking along the street, I saw an old friend.
items.hint: Walking and seeing at the same time. Imperfective: идя.
items.explanation: Simultaneous: идя (impf verbal adverb of идти). Both happen at the same time.
